text: Project Alpha kickoff meeting was held on 2023-03-01.
Alpha's approved annual budget is 120000 USD.
Alpha's revised annual budget is 150000 USD.
The Alpha security review was signed off by Dana Ruiz.
Alpha stores its primary data in PostgreSQL.
Alpha's public launch is scheduled for Q4 2023.
Project Beta's approved annual budget is 90000 USD.
Beta kickoff meeting was held on 2023-04-01.
The Beta security review was signed off by Evan Cole.
Beta uses Redis for its caching layer.
